`final class ThreadUtils`<br/>

## Method details

<a id="ThreadUtils-method-daemonFactory"></a>

### daemonFactory

`ThreadFactory daemonFactory(String name)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns a thread factory whose threads are daemons named `name/1`, `name/2`…, so they never keep the program running.

<a id="ThreadUtils-method-daemonThread"></a>

### daemonThread

`Thread daemonThread(Runnable task, String name)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns a daemon thread named `name` that runs `task`, not started.

<a id="ThreadUtils-method-runOnRenderThread"></a>

### runOnRenderThread

`void runOnRenderThread(Runnable task)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Runs `task` at once on the render thread, or hands it to the thread bridge, which runs it on the render thread at the next frame.
